## Checklist

- [ ] I read CONTRIBUTING.md and agree to the Code of Conduct (CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
- [ ] This pull request is focused on one change, and it is linked to an issue if it is large
- [ ] No secrets, keys or `.env` files are committed
- [ ] `pnpm check` passes
- [ ] New behavior has tests in the relevant `test/` folder
- [ ] No tokens, passwords or personal data are logged or stored
- [ ] Keycloak Admin calls are only in `packages/keycloak-client`
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior or setup changed
